title: Deposits into a Pocketwire Savings Vault
content:
**1. When a deposit can be made.** A deposit into a Pocketwire Savings Vault can be made while the vault status is opening, active or time-locked. The status is read from the vault's own record at the time of the deposit.

**2. Where deposits come from.** Each deposit is recorded with its source: the personal balance, an external bank, a round-up, a direct deposit split or an autosave.

**3. Effect on the personal account.** Deposits from the personal balance, round-ups and autosave move money out of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account, and appear on the personal account's ledger as a transfer to savings.

**4. Deposits from an external bank.** A deposit funded from an external bank stays unavailable for withdrawal for the tier's deposit hold of calendar days.

**5. The vault balance.** The vault balance is the money saved in the vault: deposits, interest and bonuses are added to it, and withdrawals and fees are taken out of it.

## Status table

| Vault status | Deposit can be made |
|---|---|
| Opening | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Time-locked | Yes |
| Frozen | No |
| Closed | No |

## Sources and their effect

| Deposit source | Moves money out of the personal account | Unavailable for withdrawal during the deposit hold |
|---|---|---|
| Personal balance | Yes | Not stated by these terms |
| Round-up | Yes | Not stated by these terms |
| Autosave | Yes | Not stated by these terms |
| External bank | Not stated by these terms | Yes |
| Direct deposit split | Not stated by these terms | Not stated by these terms |

## Basis Q&A

**Can money be added to a time-locked vault?** Yes. A time-locked vault accepts deposits.

**Can money be added to a frozen vault?** No. Deposits are made only while the vault is opening, active or time-locked.

**Can a vault that has not yet been funded receive money?** Yes. A vault in opening status accepts deposits; that is how it receives its first deposit.
